words.meaning: Having a strong desire to achieve success or power.
words.example: Maria is ambitious and dreams of becoming a scientist.

words.meaning: Sure of your own abilities; not nervous or afraid.
words.example: She felt confident before her speech because she had practiced a lot.

words.meaning: Eager to learn or know more about something.
words.example: The curious child asked her teacher why the sky is blue.

words.meaning: The ability to understand and share another person's feelings.
words.example: Good doctors show empathy toward their patients.

words.meaning: A state of peaceful agreement; different parts fitting well together.
words.example: The two neighboring families have lived in harmony for years.

words.meaning: Doing something well with no wasted time or effort.
words.example: The new machine is efficient and finishes the work twice as fast.

words.meaning: Exact and accurate; without any mistakes.
words.example: The scientist took precise measurements of the liquid.

words.meaning: Able to change or adapt easily; able to bend without breaking.
words.example: Our schedule is flexible, so we can meet any day this week.

words.meaning: An idea or guess that can be tested by experiment or research.
words.example: The students formed a hypothesis before starting their science project.

words.meaning: Showing strong, intense force, aggression, or feeling.
words.example: A fierce storm knocked down several trees in the park.

words.meaning: Willing to give more of something, like money or time, than is expected.
words.example: The generous man donated most of his savings to the orphanage.

words.meaning: Not proud; modest about one's own abilities or importance.
words.example: Despite winning the award, the humble student thanked her whole team.

words.meaning: Faithful and committed to a person, group, or cause.
words.example: The loyal dog waited by the door for its owner to return.

words.meaning: To keep trying to do something despite difficulty.
words.example: Even after failing twice, she decided to persevere and try again.

words.meaning: A deep feeling of sympathy for someone who is suffering, with a desire to help.
words.example: The nurse treated every patient with great compassion.

words.meaning: Made up of many different kinds or types.
words.example: Our school has a diverse group of students from many countries.

words.meaning: Introducing new ideas or methods; original and creative.
words.example: The company is known for its innovative designs in mobile phones.

words.meaning: Able to be trusted to do what is expected; dependable.
words.example: You can always count on him; he is a reliable friend.

words.meaning: Willing to accept or respect ideas, beliefs, or behavior that are different from your own.
words.example: A tolerant society welcomes people of different religions and cultures.

words.meaning: To study something carefully in order to understand it.
words.example: The detective had to analyze every clue to solve the mystery.
